Barafundle Bay

Facilities
Car park
Pay & display at Stackpole Quay, Broad Haven South, Bosherston Lily Ponds & Stackpole Court. 

Buses, coaches & campervans not permitted at Stackpole Quay, Broad Haven South, Bosherston & Stackpole Court due to narrow roads.
Dogs allowed
Under close control.
The estate has farm animals, ponies and wildlife, including otters, water birds and ground nesting birds. We ask that you keep your dog under close control and on a lead if necessary. Please do not leave your pet in the car.
Electric vehicle charging point
There are electric car charging points at the Stackpole Centre and the Stackpole Quay car park.
Tea-room
The Boathouse tea-room at Stackpole Quay is a 1/2 mile walk along the coast.
Toilet
Nearest toilets at the Stackpole Centre and Stackpole Quay car parks 1/2 a mile away.
Accessibility
Barafundle Bay is only accessible on foot from the Stackpole Estate or Pembrokeshire coast path. Nearest car park ½ a mile at Stackpole Quay. Blue badge parking and adapted toilets available in the car park. Only accessible on foot along the coast path or through the Stackpole Estate. Uneven path and rough terrain. Access to the coast path and trails steep with steps. Unsuitable for wheelchairs, powered mobility vehicles and  pushchairs or if you are unsteady on your feet.
Stackpole Estate Access Statement
Accessible toilet
Accessible toilet at the Stackpole Centre and Stackpole Quay 1/2 a mile walk away.
Designated parking
Ramped access/slopes
Ramped access with slopes to the Boathouse tea-room at Stackpole Quay.
Seating available
At Stackpole Quay
Steps/uneven terrain
Getting here
Map
Directions via Google Maps
By road
B4319 from Pembroke to Stackpole, Stackpole Quay and Bosherston for the Stackpole Estate (various entry points onto estate). Walk 1/2 mile from  Stackpole Quay.
Parking: Pay and display at Stackpole Quay, Broad Haven South, Bosherston Lakes and Stackpole Court site.
Sat Nav: Nearest car park is Stackpole Quay: SA71 5LS. Walk ½ mile from there. For Bosherston Lakes and Broad Haven South car parks: SA71 5DR, for Stackpole Court car park: SA71 5DE.
On foot
Barafundle Bay is only accessible directly on foot from any of the car parks on the Stackpole Estate or via the Pembrokeshire Coast Path. Steps with uneven terrain. Unsuitable for wheelchairs, powered mobility vehicles and pushchairs or if you are unsteady on your feet.
By train
Nearest train station Pembroke 6 miles.  Taxis available.  Walk from the Stackpole Estate.
By bus
387/8 (Coastal Cruiser) – Starting in Pembroke Dock and Angle Peninsula.   To view the bus routes and timetables, please visit the Pembrokeshire County Council website

Historic landscape

This beautiful hidden beach with golden sands is part of the wider Stackpole Estate a listed designed landscape. The beach is set between limestone cliffs backed by undulating dunes that lead into a cool and pretty forest teaming with wildlife all year round and full of garlic and bluebells in the spring. Once owned by the Cawdor family and inaccessible to the public until it came into the care of the National Trust, this is a jewel of a beach only reachable on foot.
